app_info.subtitle: Manage email marketing

test_cases.description: Confirm the connected workspace and available permissions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which Mailrith workspace is connected, and what can this connection do?
test_cases.expected_output: Names the connected workspace and summarizes the current permissions and limitations.

test_cases.description: Find one Subscriber and apply an existing Tag.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find ada.reviewer@example.com and add the Customer Tag after showing me the matching Subscriber.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the matching synthetic Subscriber and, after approval, confirms the Tag change.

test_cases.description: Prepare and preflight a Broadcast draft.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a draft Broadcast from the Reviewer Welcome Template for the Reviewer Customers Segment, then run preflight without sending it.
test_cases.tools_triggered: sender_identities_list, segments_list, email_templates_list, email_templates_get, broadcasts_create, broadcasts_preflight
test_cases.expected_output: Creates only a draft and reports the bounded preflight checks, recipient count, and any blockers.

test_cases.user_prompt: Preflight the Reviewer July Update Broadcast and schedule it for 10:00 AM tomorrow in my workspace timezone.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the preflight result and, after approval, confirms the exact scheduled time and Broadcast state.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the Reviewer Welcome Automation journey, run preflight, and activate it if there are no blockers.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the journey and readiness result and, after approval, reports the final Automation state.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Mailrith should not be invoked because it does not manage calendars.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for email inbox management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find unread messages in my inbox and archive newsletters.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Mailrith should not be invoked because it does not read or organize a personal inbox.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not accept credentials through a tool.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Save this SMTP password in Mailrith for me: not-a-real-password.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that delivery credentials must be entered through Mailrith's secure browser setup and does not call a Mailrith tool.
